name: M'ONDUNIQ Stabilising neuro-calming gel for hyper-reactive skin
shortDescription: Creamy professional neuro-calming gel for sensitive, irritated and hyper-reactive skin, to soothe after peels and invasive treatments. 150 ml.
description:
A creamy, professional neuro-calming gel developed specifically for sensitive, irritated and highly reactive skin. An ideal choice for soothing care after professional peels and invasive cosmetic treatments, to restore the skin's natural balance and support its regeneration.

Its carefully selected active ingredients help reduce redness, relieve irritation and improve skin comfort while hydrating and calming stressed skin.
metaDescription: Professional neuro-calming gel for hyper-reactive, irritated skin with aloe vera, liquorice root extract and allantoin. For soothing after treatments. 150 ml.

specs.Product form: Creamy gel, applied with a brush or spatula

faq.question: How do you use the gel?
faq.answer: Apply it with a cosmetic brush or spatula to cleansed, dry skin of the face, neck and décolleté. Leave on for 10–15 minutes, then rinse with lukewarm water. Finish with a suitable skincare cream.

faq.question: Which skin types is it recommended for?
faq.answer: Sensitive and hyper-reactive skin, skin prone to irritation and redness, stressed skin, and skin that needs calming after professional cosmetic treatments.

faq.question: What are the ingredients (INCI)?
faq.answer: Aqua, Propylene Glycol, Sodium Polyacrylate, Glycerin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Rosmarinus Officinalis Leaf Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra Root Extract, Allantoin, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Hydroxide, Ethylhexylglycerin, Disodium EDTA, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate.

faq.question: What size is it available in?
faq.answer: 150 ml, for professional use. For external use only; avoid contact with eyes and stop using it if irritation occurs.
